instances.name: AccelerationDisabled
instances.value: True switches the Acceleration layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the rev layers and turbo carry acceleration). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: CoastDisabled
instances.value: True switches the Coast layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the off-load rev layers carry coasting). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: DriftLoopDisabled
instances.value: True switches the DriftLoop layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the stabiliser strain layer carries drifting). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: AccelerationEnterDisabled
instances.value: True switches the AccelerationEnter layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the tip-in bark replaces it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: AccelerationReleaseDisabled
instances.value: True switches the AccelerationRelease layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the blow-off and pops replace it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: DriftEnterDisabled
instances.value: True switches the DriftEnter layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the stabiliser strain layer replaces it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

instances.name: BoostBodyAssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: BoostBodyGain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: BoostBodyPitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

instances.name: BoostBodyPitchMin
instances.value: Playback speed of the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev when its drive value is 0.

instances.name: BoostBodyPitchMax
instances.value: Playback speed of the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev when its drive value is 1.

instances.name: WindBuffetAssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: WindBuffetGain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: WindBuffetPitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

instances.name: WindBuffetPitchMin
instances.value: Playback speed of the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph when its drive value is 0.

instances.name: WindBuffetPitchMax
instances.value: Playback speed of the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph when its drive value is 1.

instances.name: Pop1AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Pop1Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Pop1Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: Pop2AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Pop2Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Pop2Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: Pop3AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Pop3Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Pop3Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: Pop4AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Pop4Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Pop4Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: Bang1AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Bang1Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Bang1Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: Bang2AssetId
instances.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

instances.name: Bang2Gain
instances.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

instances.name: Bang2Pitch
instances.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

instances.name: BoostFadeInSeconds
instances.value: Fade-in of BoostLoop and BoostBody, so the boost lands with its ignition.

instances.name: BoostDuckDb
instances.value: How far the rev layers are turned down while boosting, in decibels. Only applies when BoostLoop or BoostBody has an asset.

instances.name: BoostDuckInSeconds
instances.value: How fast the engine ducks under a boost.

instances.name: BoostDuckOutSeconds
instances.value: How fast the engine recovers after a boost.

instances.name: PopBangStrength
instances.value: FeelPopStrength at or above which a bang (Bang1/Bang2) plays instead of a pop.

instances.name: PopPitchJitter
instances.value: Random playback-speed spread on each pop or bang (0.06 = plus or minus 6 %).

instances.name: DriverWindStartMph
instances.value: Speed at which driver wind starts to be heard on this profile.

instances.name: DriverWindFullMph
instances.value: Speed at which driver wind is at full gain and top pitch. Gain follows (speed / DriverWindFullMph) ^ DriverWindExponent.

instances.name: DriverWindExponent
instances.value: Power curve of driver wind gain against speed.

instances.name: DriverWindSpeedPitchMin
instances.value: Driver wind playback speed at rest.

instances.name: DriverWindSpeedPitchMax
instances.value: Driver wind playback speed at DriverWindFullMph.

instances.name: WindBuffetStartMph
instances.value: Speed at which the wind buffet loop starts to enter.

instances.name: WindBuffetFullMph
instances.value: Speed at which the wind buffet loop is full.
